subject.title: feat: avatar upload UI, self-service profiles, server-side avatar route

question: Should profile avatars perform an automatic third-party Gravatar lookup for every profile without an uploaded image, or must that behavior be explicitly enabled by the operator/user?
rationale: This is a lasting privacy and product-default decision, not a mechanical correctness choice: the proxy changes who receives an email-derived identifier and when remote content becomes part of the UI.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the existing uploaded-avatar/initials behavior by default and enable Gravatar only through an approved, documented privacy setting.

options.title: Accept the default remote fallback
options.body: Land the automatic Gravatar behavior with clear operator-facing disclosure, cache/deletion semantics, and live proof of the intended privacy boundary.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the existing uploaded-avatar/initials behavior by default and enable Gravatar only through an approved, documented privacy setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged profile and avatar work establishes the relevant feature-history ownership, while the protected label requires a human product decision.
